W: Wet stone. Someone has scratched a tally into it. They stopped at forty.
G: Iron bars, cold and close together. Down the passage, a guard is snoring.
b: A bunk with a straw mattress. It has seen better centuries.
,: Old straw. Something small lives in it, and would like you to leave.
k: A stub of candle on an iron stand. The guards must have missed it.
It burns like the Archive's candles.
2: Iron bars, cold and close together. Down the passage, a guard is snoring.
p: Iron bars. Somebody on the other side is breathing very loudly.
1: A ladder up, to the floor above.
t: The guards' table. Half a sandwich, a dice cup, and a sign: ON WATCH 24/7. Under it, in different handwriting: (mostly).
c: A torch in a bracket, guttering.
3: (The door at the top of the guards' stair. Locked. They locked it behind them.)
(No way out up there. I'll have to find another way.)
4: The cell door. Locked, and the key is on Gary's belt. Gary is asleep.

objects.name: Brannoc
lines: AH! Stay back! I am armed!
...Very well. I am not armed. But I am still dangerous!

answer: I am Brannoc. Once, I was a prince.
I fell asleep and woke in a cocoon. Someone freed me, then vanished before I could thank him.

questions.ask: Why are you cowering in the corner?
answer: Cowering? I am heroically defending this corner. There is a difference!
I wandered from my cocoon into a kingdom I no longer knew. A cat startled me, and I stumbled into an apple cart.
Now I serve three life sentences.
Only to apples.
Escape? Impossible! The guards keep watch day and night.
And these bars... forged by giants, surely. Not even a battering ram could—

questions.ask: Some prince. Beaten by an apple cart.
answer: ...By the saints. That is unkind, friend.
True, I grant you. It was a very large cart. But unkind.
* Brannoc turns back to his corner, and guards it a little harder.

farewell: Go on, then. I shall hold this corner. Someone must.

answer: I know.
Five years I've had to think about it. I'd say it now.
He hasn't sneezed since.

objects.name: Nails
lines: The king asked for ice water.
I gave him one ice cube.

answer: Ice is expensive.
I'm not made of ice.

questions.ask: One ice cube? You deserve it.
answer: I know.
Next time it's half a cube. Then we'll see who deserves what.

objects.name: Silas Seen
lines: I left the king on read for twenty minutes.

answer: Fifty life sentences.
Do the maths.

questions.ask: Twenty minutes? I'd have left him on read for a week.
answer: Show-off.

objects.name: Gary
lines: I'm not going to stop you. I don't get paid enough for this.

questions.ask: Could I please have the keys?
answer: * Gary thinks about it. Then he shrugs.
Sure. Why not.
* You received Gary's Cell Keys!
then: You unlock the cells. One, two, three.
NAILS: I STOLE THE OTHER ICE CUBES!
OLD MOTT: I PUT PEPPER IN THE KING'S SANDWICH!
They're up the ladder and gone.
You turn back to Gary. Gary is gone too.

answer: Gary.
Gary. Of the cells.
There was a Gary of the gate. He got promoted. Now he's Gary of the other gate.

questions.ask: How much do they pay you?
answer: We don't get paid at all.
They call it 'the honour of the Crown.'
I can't eat the honour of the Crown. I've tried.
At the Kaloseum. Big fight tonight.
Somebody had to stay. Somebody is always Gary.

questions.ask: Aren't you going to stop me?
answer: No.
Still no.
It says that on the sign.
I'm the 24/7.
Useless Lump. Of the cells.
It's a promotion, really. I don't get paid for that either.

farewell: Close the door on your way out. There is no door. Close it anyway.

objects.name: Brannoc
lines: I am not sulking. I am holding the corner. Again.

answer: ...Truly? You would have me?
You jest. You do not jest? Then my sword is yours. Truly, this time.
then: Brannoc snatches up his sword and hurries after you, beaming.

questions.ask: Why did you come back here?
answer: It is the only place in this world I know.
And the guards wave at me now. Most unsettling.

questions.ask: Stay in your corner. You'd only slow me down.
answer: ...Yes. Yes, I expect I would.
I shall stay, then. In case you change your mind.
I am very good at waiting. It is the one thing I am good at.

farewell: I shall be here. In the corner. Should you need a corner held.

objects.name: Kaldor
lines: Five hundred years, and not one grey hair. And now look at me.
They took my shadows. My master never even said goodbye.

answer: I never knew. Something in the dark that knew my name.
It gave me everything I ever wanted. It asked for one thing: build the strongest army I could, and go to no war without its say.
I waited a hundred years for it to change its mind. Then I stopped waiting.
What is an army for, if not war?
I built the strongest army the world has ever seen. It seemed a shame to waste it.
The guard tells me the straw is the best part. I think he's lying. I think he likes to watch.

farewell: This was my nephew's cell, once. Or so they say.
